name: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
benefit:
Under this scheme, eligible students will receive the following financial assistance::

  - The students will receive ₹500/- per month for a maximum of 10 months, totaling up to ₹5,000/- annually.
  - The students with a disability of 40% or more will receive ₹1,000/- per month for up to 10 months, totaling a maximum of ₹10,000/- annually.

**Note:** The benefits under this scheme are available fo
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be a regular student.
   1. The student should be studying at a government or recognized non-government higher or technical institute in Rajasthan.
   1. Students should have passed the 12th examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, in the current year with a minimum of 60% marks and secured a position within the top one lakh of the board&#39;s merit list.
   1. Disabled students should have a disability of 40% or more.
   1. The total annual income of the applicant&#39;s parents or guardians should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
   1. The student should not be receiving benefits from any other scholarship or equivalent scheme provided by the Government of India or the State Government.
   1. The student should have a savings account in a nationalized bank.
   1. The applicant should possess a valid Aadhaar card.
   1. The student should have a Jan Aadhaar Card (Bhamashah Card).
